project_type: Spring Boot Java backend + Next.js 15 TypeScript frontend (two separate repos)
build_system: Maven with spotless (backend), npm with Next.js (frontend)
test_framework: JUnit (backend), ESLint (frontend) - no test coverage required for this task
test_command: mvn spotless:apply -B && mvn spotless:check -B (backend), npm run lint (frontend)
verification_instructions: Backend: run mvn spotless:apply -B && mvn spotless:check -B in /Users/mathew/Merchant-Backend. Frontend: run npm run lint in /Users/mathew/merchant-fe
contribution_requirements: Backend must pass spotless formatting checks. Frontend must pass linting. No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md exists.

key_patterns.backend_grpc_client: GrpcClient.java uses configStub for tms-config calls; pattern: logRequest → try configStub.method → toMap for success / catch grpcError
key_patterns.backend_controller: Controllers use @RequiredArgsConstructor, return ApiResponse<T>, inject services via constructor
key_patterns.backend_dto: DTOs use Lombok @Data @Builder, Jackson @JsonProperty for snake_case
key_patterns.frontend_component: Uses shadcn/ui components (Card, CardHeader, CardContent, CardTitle), cn() for class merging, apiRequest from @/lib/api
key_patterns.frontend_layout: InfoRow component in super-merchant uses flex-col (label on top, value below) instead of side-by-side
key_patterns.frontend_state: useState/useCallback pattern, apiRequest with suppressToast: true for fetches

directory_structure.backend: /Users/mathew/Merchant-Backend - Spring Boot backend, modules/settlement/controller and modules/grpc/service
